# IT@Cornell

> > IT@Cornell provides comprehensive technology services, support, and guidance for Cornell University's computing infrastructure, collaboration tools, security practices, and emerging AI capabilities.

IT@Cornell is Cornell University's central information technology organization, offering institutional support for Microsoft 365, email systems, file collaboration, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies like generative AI. The site serves as the primary resource for Cornell faculty, staff, and students seeking IT services, best practices, and technical guidance.

## Key Topics

- NetID
- Microsoft 365
- Email Management
- Cybersecurity
- Passphrase Security
- Generative AI
- Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
- ChatGPT
- File Collaboration
- RingCentral
- Box
- Web Accessibility
- IT Services
- Account Recovery
- Cornell Security

## Generative AI & Emerging Technologies

- [Generative AI Services](https://it.cornell.edu/ai-strategy): Cornell-supported generative AI tools including Copilot, ChatGPT, and prompt engineering resources

## Security & Account Management

- [Secure 16-Character Passphrases for NetIDs](https://it.cornell.edu/news/secure-16-character-passphrases-netids): Updated NetID passphrase security requirements and best practices for Cornell users

## Core IT Services & Tools

- [Current Top Ten Hot IT Topics](https://it.cornell.edu/news/current-top-ten-hot-it-topics): Guide to top IT@Cornell services including Microsoft 365, email, and collaboration tools

## Compliance & Accessibility

- [Before Deadline: Cornell's Web Accessibility Readiness](https://it.cornell.edu/news/deadline-cornells-web-accessibility-readiness): Cornell's ADA Title II compliance and web accessibility readiness initiatives

## Optional

- [New Role, New Department, New Phone](https://it.cornell.edu/news/new-role-new-department-new-phone): Guide for managing RingCentral phone accounts during employee transitions and departmental moves
